read.en: Arm fell 5.3% on Nov 4 to $191.80, trading between $189.89 and $209.50 on heavy volume. It is below the falling 5-day ($205.16), 10-day ($213.21), 30-day ($251.79) and 100-day ($276.79) averages and the rising 200-day ($230.29). MACD has been below its signal since Oct 7 and below zero, histogram widening; Parabolic SAR has been bearish since Oct 30 ($233.89), and RSI is 32.6.
read.zh: Arm 11月4日下跌 5.3%，收于 $191.80，盘中区间 $189.89–209.50，成交量放大。股价位于下行的 5 日（$205.16）、10 日（$213.21）、30 日（$251.79）和 100 日均线（$276.79）以及上行的 200 日均线（$230.29）下方。MACD 自 10月7日起位于信号线下方且在零轴之下，柱状图扩大；抛物线 SAR 自 10月30日起看空（$233.89），RSI 为 32.6。

read.en: The high of $209.50 stalled at the $208–209 resistance, and the close broke both the $198.8–200.9 and $193.9–196.1 supports, which now act as resistance. Resistance is $193.9–196.1, then $198.8–200.9 and $205.2–209.5 (5-day, Oct 22 low, Nov 4 high). Support is $189.9 (Nov 4 low), then $183.2 (Oct 27, 2025 high). A close above $196.1 would target $199–201; below $189.9, $183.

r.en: Oct 30 low $198.8; Nov 3 low $200; May 12 low $200.9
